description: This file defines the OAuthKey class, which manages OAuth consumer keys within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, caching, and deleting OAuth keys, and contains class properties related to OAuth key management.

classes.name: OAuthKey
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer key, providing methods to retrieve, cache, and delete OAuth keys within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthKey record by its consumer key.

methods.name: fetchKey
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthKey object by key, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the OAuth key and associated tokens from the database.
